_readme: Photo backfill for products that arrive from the POS without an image. 'byName' is matched on the product name with punctuation, spaces and any (bracketed) words removed and letters lower-cased, so '( weed ) Crispy Boy Lager Can' matches 'crispyboylagercan'. Add your own entries here: key = the flattened name, value = an image URL or a path like 'assets/crunchberrie.jpg'. 'generic' supplies a category-style photo for anything with no name match; set GENERIC_PRODUCT_IMAGES=0 in Vercel to turn those off and fall back to the leaf placeholder instead. A value may also be a LIST of URLs instead of one: the first is the main picture and the rest appear as a shot strip in the product popup. That is how a strain leads with its Botanical Legends card and then shows photographs of the actual jar — put the card first, the photos after.
_readme2: byKeyword is a looser net: the product name is flattened and scanned for each of these words, longest first, so '(Beer) Wila weizen (1Jar' finds 'weizen' and '(Food) Chicken Karaage' finds 'karaage'. Anything still unmatched gets a generated tile from /api/tile — a unique coloured card drawn from the product's own name, so no two products look alike.
_readme3: Weed/flower products (name or category matching weed/flower/exotic/topshelf/midgrade/indica/sativa) only ever match the shop's own cdn.shopify.com photos or an exact byName entry - never generic stock keywords, never a category photo. Strains named after food (Chocolate Crip, Tea Time, Durian Pop) would otherwise get food pictures. Unmatched strains get their generated /api/tile card.
